user.title: Connect to Open Parcels
user.description: Enter the address of your Open Parcels server and an API token with the read and write scopes. Create the token in the Open Parcels web interface under Settings.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.10:4000 or the Tailscale address.
data_description.api_token: Needs the scopes read and write.

discovery_confirm.title: Open Parcels found
discovery_confirm.description: An Open Parcels server was found at {url}. Enter an API token with the read and write scopes to add it.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The Open Parcels server at {url} refused the API token. Enter a new token with the read and write scopes.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.10:4000 or the Tailscale address.
data_description.api_token: Needs the scopes read and write.

error.cannot_connect: The server could not be reached. Check the address.
error.invalid_auth: The server refused the API token.
error.missing_scope: The API token needs both the read and the write scope.
error.unknown: The server gave an unexpected answer.

abort.already_configured: This Open Parcels server is already set up.

data_description.resync_minutes: Changes arrive live through the event stream. This slow resync only catches anything the stream missed.
data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update. Off by default.
data_description.order_entities: Add a sensor per open order, with its items and parcels. Off by default.
data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel (package) by its tracking code. The carrier is detected from the code unless you name it.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: The Open Parcels server. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The tracking code of the parcel.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: The carrier's Open Parcels id, for example dhl. Leave empty to detect it.

label.name: Label
label.description: An optional name for the parcel.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Whether you receive or send the parcel.

archive_parcel.name: Archive parcel
archive_parcel.description: Archive a parcel so it no longer shows up. Name it by tracking code or by id.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: The Open Parcels server. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The tracking code of the parcel.

parcel_id.name: Parcel id
parcel_id.description: The Open Parcels id of the parcel (the id attribute).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-read everything from the server. With a parcel, first run the sources that follow it.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: The Open Parcels server. Only needed when more than one is set up.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: Optional: the tracking code of a parcel to update first.

parcel_id.name: Parcel id
parcel_id.description: Optional: the Open Parcels id of a parcel to update first.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
trigger_type.parcel_live_updated: A parcel's live courier tracking changed
